markdown_projection.authority_note: The JSON contract is primary. The retained legacy Markdown is reference-only and MUST NOT regenerate or overwrite this enriched folded Stage contract.

consolidation.supersession_rule: The current Stage contract supersedes every older Stage-specific requirement/implementation regardless of build status (STAGE-REQ-SUPERSESSION-001/002). Folded stubs contribute lineage only, no legacy compatibility.

microtask_plan.allocation_rule: One MT per STAGE-REQ-* requirement mapped by its lane tag, plus foundational spine MTs (L00-L04) and integration/promotion MTs (L22). acceptance-registry.yaml rows are the per-MT proof targets.
microtask_plan.note: Prep-only. MT contracts + index exist for planning, status tracking, and state recovery. MT-125 is the cross-cutting Stage SurrealDB foundation and is a predecessor of feature implementation. This does NOT activate the WP; activation still requires refinement + signature + official packet per activation_contract.

storage_contract.authority: Handshake-managed embedded SurrealDB/EventLedger is the only Stage product, runtime, test, fixture, cache, recovery, and proof database authority.
storage_contract.runtime_identity: Stage uses the canonical application-bootstrap SurrealStorage handle through an injected typed StageRepository boundary; Stage MUST NOT open a feature-private database or call feature-local open_default() in production.
storage_contract.schema_ownership: Stage owns typed SCHEMAFULL Stage tables, indexes, assertions, authenticated record-user permissions, and SurrealKit rollouts. Stage does not read or mutate another subsystem's private tables.
storage_contract.artifact_boundary: ArtifactStore owns captured/downloaded bytes, manifests, hashes, retention, garbage collection, and materialization. Stage persists opaque ArtifactHandles, capture intent, source correlation, lineage, and workflow state in SurrealDB/EventLedger.
storage_contract.browser_profile_boundary: Engine-native profile directories may hold cookies, cache, local storage, IndexedDB, service workers, DRM state, and other browser-engine materialization. Those files are isolated runtime state, not an alternative Stage product database or canonical backup authority.
required_proof: official SurrealDB Rust SDK access through the typed storage boundary
SurrealKit SCHEMAFULL rollout with assertions, indexes, and authenticated record-user permissions
real embedded SurrealDB tests in a WP-scoped namespace/database
restart/reopen, concurrency, permission-isolation, rollout, backup/restore, and database-outage proof where the MT touches those behaviors
zero-match guards for forbidden database dependencies, URLs, drivers, migrations, fixtures, caches, fallbacks, and compatibility paths

spec_trace.roadmap_pointer: Resolve current authority via .GOV/spec/SPEC_CURRENT.md; Stage master-spec topic rewrite is DEFERRED (STAGE-DEC-006/016) until planning concludes. Roadmap: Handshake Stage (governed high-volume browser + intake + Stage Apps), Phase 1/Week-5 track.

draft_scope.intent:
- What: The single Handshake Stage umbrella WP: a Handshake-native, high-volume, low-CPU governed web browser surface with 3000+ durable tab records, bounded live renderers, project asset intake (download/capture -> ArtifactStore -> Lens/Atelier/CKC), native/local+cloud AI steering, capture/portability, ASR lineage, translation/export/search, and Stage Apps. Stage durable authority uses the shared embedded SurrealDB/EventLedger substrate through a typed StageRepository.
- Why: A normal browser whose one defining requirement is holding 3000+ tabs without taxing CPU (STAGE-DEC-020), leaving headroom for Handshake heavy tools (ComfyUI, editor clones), while folding the older Stage-owned stubs into one direction without creating a second product database.
draft_scope.scope_sketch:
- Authority: the hardened planning corpus at .GOV/reference/stage_mvp_planning/ (index.yaml, 02-decision-register.md, requirements-and-traceability.yaml, acceptance-registry.yaml, 10-microtask-lane-and-dag-seed.md) is the scope source, NOT this summary.
- IN_SCOPE: 23 lanes L00..L22 (topology/registries/kernel/diagnostics spine; native shell; history/bookmarks/import; high-volume scheduler; WebView2 production adapter; Servo strategic adapter; network/permissions/security; sessions/auth/secrets; agent control; Stage Apps; capture/archive; downloads/intake/ASR; Loom/search; translation/export; accessibility/localization/manual; legacy WP-12 Stage removal + active-WP integration; packaging/update/supply-chain; backup/support/recovery; integration/promotion/closure). Folds WP-1-Stage-Media-Artifact-Portability-v1 (L14) and WP-1-Stage-ASR-Transcript-Lineage-v1 (L15).
- Locked direction: downloads never stopped/frozen/dormant by lifecycle machinery (STAGE-DEC-019); Servo strategic primary, WebView2 bootstrap conditioned on authenticated-YouTube session-import viability (STAGE-DEC-021, spike PASS 2026-07-20); STAGE-WP-COMPLETE (Chromium retired/demoted) is the only finished state (STAGE-DEC-022); Stage durable authority is embedded SurrealDB/EventLedger only, with no Turso/libSQL/SQLite/PostgreSQL or private feature database (STAGE-DEC-023).
- OUT_OF_SCOPE: activation/implementation (prep only); adjacent WPs (Media Downloader, Artifact System, ASR Transcribe, Loom, Lens/Atelier/CKC, WP-1 orchestration, WP-12 editors) remain their own packets; Stage is their versioned consumer.
draft_scope.acceptance_criteria: Stub-level only (not execution): every STAGE-REQ-* requirement has one tracked MT with lane + acceptance-row proof target; MT-125 establishes the cross-cutting SurrealDB storage foundation; every MT carries the Stage storage obligation; folded stubs are archived + superseded with no legacy authority; MT index provides status tracking + state recovery; WP remains non-executable until refinement + signature + official packet.
draft_scope.risks_unknowns:
- Durability of imported YouTube session over time under DBSC (STAGE-RW-021 open).
- Load-storm CPU, GPU, and virtualized-sidebar per-frame cost not yet measured (STAGE-RW-022 increment 2).
- Active-WP baselines (WP-1 orchestration, WP-12 editors, CKC) are dirty/in-progress; dependency gates fail-closed until validated baselines bind.
- WP-KERNEL-012 and WP-1 Multi-Model Orchestration currently carry parallel SurrealDB remediation branches; Stage activation must bind their reconciled shared storage/bootstrap/schema baseline rather than copying either branch privately.

assumptions_to_attack: A stub is planning metadata, not execution authority.
Stub Markdown may contain stale draft scope until activated through a signed packet.
Apps must not treat stub contracts as runnable work packets.
A Stage-private Turso/libSQL/SQLite/PostgreSQL database would be harmless isolation.
minimum_controls: Require official packet contract before Coder or Validator launch.
Fail drift checks when stub Markdown changes without contract regeneration.
Require MT-125 and every data-bearing MT to prove SurrealDB-exclusive authority through the shared typed storage boundary.
